title: Sukhitam
text: 1 Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2 Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro || pe|| || 3 Yam bhikkhave passeyyātha sukhitaṃ sajjitaṃ niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ Amhehi pi evarūpam paccanubhūtaṃ iminā dīghena addhunāti [page 187] XV. 13. 7] DUTIYO VAGGO 187 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...]|| || 4 Tam kissa hetu || || Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro pubbākoṭi na paññāyati || pe || || alām vimuccitunti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
